title: SpongeBob SquarePants and Friends - Battle for Volcano Island (Europe) (En,Fr,De,Es,It,Nl)

fields.name: header_magic_game002
fields.evidence: FUN_08058298/FUN_0805823c wrappers at call sites in FUN_08033ca0/33e98/33f24/33f8c/3440c/3447c; both .sav files after reversing each 8-byte block.

fields.name: header_field_A_u16
fields.evidence: FUN_08033f8c repair body; global .sav logical header+8 = 0xFFFFFFFF in both files.

fields.name: slot_header_checksum
fields.evidence: FUN_08033e98 hash-compare body; no occupied slot in samples. Per-slot offsets are header-relative 12 (add slot base 0/0x98/0x130).

fields.name: global_header_checksum
fields.evidence: Verified byte-exact on both samples (see checksums[0]); FUN_0803440c/3447c store, FUN_08033ca0 compare.

fields.name: header_status
fields.evidence: Branch tests (*(u32*)(hdr+0x10) < 2, != 0) in FUN_08033e98/FUN_08033ca0 and observed values in both files.

fields.name: slot_0_payload
fields.evidence: FUN_08033e98 reads slot*0x98+0x18 length 0x80 into shared buffer and hashes it; no FUN_0803e6b4(slot+0x18,...,0x80) call exists in decompiled.c.

fields.name: global_payload_field_00_clamped_0_5
fields.evidence: Clamp code in FUN_08033ca0 (second pointer into payload buffer, 0..5) and the exact inter-sample diff at physical 0x1E6..0x1E7 (6 changed bytes total with the hash). Semantics (e.g. language index 0..5) are HYPOTHESIS, not asserted here.

fields.name: global_payload_field_02_clamped_0_2
fields.evidence: FUN_0803440c default write and FUN_08033ca0 clamp of *(i16*)(payload+2).

fields.name: global_payload_field_04_clamped_0_256
fields.evidence: FUN_0803440c *(u32*)(payload+4)=0xC0; FUN_0803447c copy; FUN_08033ca0 clamp 0..0x100. Semantics (volume-like 0..256 scalar) are HYPOTHESIS.

fields.name: global_payload_reserved_12_31
fields.evidence: FUN_0803440c memset 0x20 and observed zeros; FUN_08052f20 covers full 0x20 payload.
